prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in League City, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1200; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, so just call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?

A: It was at an intersection in League City, Texas. I was going through on a green light when another car came in from the side.

Q: Which direction were you traveling, and what did you see before impact?

A: I was heading straight through the intersection. The other vehicle came from my right and didn't stop for the red. I tried to brake but there wasn't time.

Q: Where did the impact hit your vehicle?

A: On the driver's side, the front door area. The airbag on my side deployed.

Q: Were you injured, and did you seek medical care?

A: Yes. My neck was stiff right away, and by that evening my lower back was aching. I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning and they diagnosed a neck and back strain.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Turning my head to check mirrors is painful, and I can't sit for long periods without my back bothering me. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Did you miss any work because of the injuries?

A: I've taken some time off and I'm working lighter duties now. I'm still getting my records together for that.

Q: Is there anything you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that the other driver admitted at the scene that they ran the light. I'd like to be paid for my medical bills and the time I've lost.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
